headline: Pikmin 4 gets a Switch 2 Edition!
title: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition November 12 | Dandori Academy | Gaming News
video_script: Pikmin 4 is getting a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition! Pikmin 4, Nintendo Switch 2 Edition plus Dandori Academy launches on November twelfth, twenty twenty six, physically and digitally. You can direct your companion Oatchi with voice commands using the built-in microphone. The new Dandori Academy mode adds timed treasure challenges, online leaderboards and seventy two stages released over time. Are you going back in? Comment below!
description: Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy launches November 12, 2026 with voice commands for Oatchi and a new Dandori Academy mode with 72 stages released over time.
